content: New-Trail.ps1 now proven end-to-end, not just authored: mint path, both reject paths, and a real bug (mislabeled reject code) caught and fixed within the same cycle. The -OutputPath addition means future exercises of this script never need to write into live .pmcro/trails/ again — this cycle was the last one that had to use a real trail as its own test subject. What worked: running the script for real immediately surfaced a bug that reading the code and the docs side by side had not caught. What to improve: pmcro-orchestrator:orchestrate run itself is still unexercised as a command — only its dependency (New-Trail.ps1) has been proven; there is no live skill runtime in this session to invoke /pmcro-orchestrator:orchestrate run as an actual command, only to hand-simulate its accept path.

next_seed.messy_seed_text: hand-simulate one full /pmcro-orchestrator:orchestrate run --task <x> call (mint-or-link branch of your choice) end to end — preconditions, the initialize call, the plan.jsonl log entry, hand-off to Planner — using -OutputPath so it costs nothing to throw away, to prove the orchestrate contract itself, not just its dependency
